title: Vibrant Low Sodium Saudi Arabian Cheese Cookies
description: A low sodium twist on traditional Saudi Arabian cheese cookies, featuring a bitter cheese-pull and a hint of dashi extract, perfect for a meal prep snack or dessert. These cookies are made with low sodium ingredients and are suitable for those with dietary restrictions.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, and baking powder.
Add the unsalted butter and mix until a dough forms.
Stir in the dashi extract, Saudi Arabian cheese, and black pepper.
Beat in the egg until well combined.
Scoop the dough into balls, about 1 inch in diameter.
Place the balls onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 15 minutes, or until the edges are lightly golden.
Remove from the oven and let cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes.
Transfer the cookies to a wire rack to cool completely.
